name: app/top-bar-action
title: TopBarAction
summary: One item in AppShell's top bar ("Ask Nyuchi AI", "Support"): an icon and a short label; a link with `href`, a button otherwise.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible from sm; the accessible name always.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab: rel="noopener" and "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers.

props.name: popovertarget
props.description: For a button that opens a popover.

props.name: current
props.description: The link is the current page (aria-current).

behaviour: A link with `href`, otherwise a type="button" button.
With an icon, the label is visually hidden below sm and stays the accessible name.

aria: An external link says so to screen readers.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Below sm only the icon shows; the label is the accessible name.
contract:
contract
  slot is "topbar-action"
  a "Support" min_height 32
  when button shows button "Ask AI"
  when external shows a "Docs"
end

checks.say: With href it is a link.
External links open safely and say so.
Without href it is a button that can open a popover.
